title: Android 15 OneUI 7 : Lost last line of widget
symptom: After updating a Samsung S21 FE 5G phone to Android 15 and OneUI 7.0, the last line of the AAPS widget is lost. Deleting and re-adding the widget does not fix the problem.
cause: Samsung has changed the grid on the screen, so the widget needs one more row to display fully.
fix: Add one more row to the widget (or place it on a blank page to ensure enough space).
evidence_quote: Samsung has changed the grid on the screen, so you now have to add one more row to the widget.
